bagPolicy.summary: Fans may bring one clear plastic or vinyl bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, a one-gallon clear freezer bag, or a small purse/clutch up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches. Large purses, backpacks, luggage, computer bags, and bags over the limit are prohibited.
allowed: clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
small purse/clutch up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches
bagPolicy.note: Complimentary bag check is available at stadium entries for prohibited bags.

parking.note: Game-day parking is available across Boise State campus and off campus. The current stadium fan guide lists reserved and day-of options; availability and event pricing vary, so use the current interactive map before arrival.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in the current Albertsons Stadium fan guide. Use the current event map and signed drop-off/pickup areas on event day.

concessions.note: Albertsons Stadium concessions are cashless; credit/debit cards, mobile payments, and prepaid debit cards are accepted. Food and beverage offerings can change by event.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking and seating are available. The current fan guide lists accessible game-day parking and wheelchair-accessible shuttle service, while the Boise State Ticket Office can assist with accessible seating.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Albertsons Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For ticket assistance, use the current Boise State Athletics Ticket Office information. Mobile-ticket or game-day issues can be handled through the main box office, subject to event instructions.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: All Albertsons Stadium entries open two hours before kickoff for Boise State football. Most tickets use an any-ticket, any-gate policy, with exceptions for Stueckle Sky Center, North End Zone, and student tickets; check the ticket for the suggested entry.
